description: Ein übersichtliches Dashboard für alle in FIWARE aufgezeichneten Wetterstationen

panels.description: Zeigt den Temperaturverlauf der ausgewählten Wetterstationen im gewünschten Zeitraum.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name as __key,
  avg(temperature) AS "WS"
FROM
  "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
  AND name IN($Station)
  AND temperature BETWEEN -30
  AND 50
GROUP BY
  time,
  name
ORDER BY
  1;

panels.title: Temperatur

panels.description: Zeigt den Verlauf der Niederschlagsintensität der ausgewählten Wetterstationen im gewünschten Zeitraum. Die Angabe in Millimetern bezieht sich dabei auf die Regenmenge, wenn die Intensität eine Stunde konstant bleibt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(precipitation) AS "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index) AND 
  name IN($Station)
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Niederschlag

panels.description: Zeigt die Windgeschwindigkeiten im gewünschten Zeitraum an. Dabei handelt es sich nicht um die Windböengeschwindigkeit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(windspeed) as "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index) AND 
  name IN($Station)
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Windgeschwindigkeit

panels.description: Zeigt den Verlauf der Intensität der Sonneneinstrahlung der ausgewählten Wetterstationen im gewünschten Zeitraum.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(solarRadiation) AS "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index) AND 
  name IN($Station)
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sonneneinstrahlung

panels.description: Zeigt die aktuellen Werte der ausgewählten Wetterstationen in den letzten fünf Minuten in nummerischer Darstellung.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  avg(temperature) AS "Temperatur [°C]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se" 
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 
  AND name IN($Station)
  AND temperature BETWEEN '-20' AND '50'

SELECT
  avg(atmosphericpressure) AS "Luftdruck [hPa]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND
  name IN($Station)

SELECT
  avg(relativehumidity) AS "Relative Luftfeuchtigkeit [%]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 
  AND name IN($Station) 
  AND relativehumidity BETWEEN '0' AND '100'

SELECT
  avg(precipitation) AS "Niederschlag [mm]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  AND name IN($Station)

SELECT
  avg(solarradiation) AS "Sonnenstrahlung [W / m²]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND
  name IN($Station)

SELECT
  avg(windspeed) AS "Windgeschwindigkeit [km / h]"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  time_index BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND
  name IN($Station)

panels.title: Aktuelle Durchschnittswerte der letzten fünf Minuten

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DISTINCT ON(entity_id) entity_id AS "tooltip",
  'Letzter Datenpunkt: ' || TO_CHAR(TIMEZONE('Europe/Berlin', time_index), 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') AS "text",
  ST_X(location) AS "latitude",
  ST_Y(location) AS "longitude"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se" 
ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON(entity_id)
  entity_id AS "tooltip",
  time_bucket('5 minutes', time_index) as time_index,
  avg(winddirection) as winddirection,
  avg(windspeed) as windspeed,
  avg(windspeed)/4.08 as windspeedPercent,
  avg(temperature) as temperature,
  ST_X(location) AS "latitude",
  ST_Y(location) AS "longitude"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se" 
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time_index)
  GROUP BY entity_id, time_index, location
  ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC

panels.description: Zeigt die aktuell gemessene Temperatur an den ausgewählten Stationen an. Im blauen Bereich besteht Frostgefahr (< 5 °C), im orangen Bereich die Gefahr von Hitzebelastung (> 30 °C).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_index AS time,
  entity_id AS __key,
  temperature AS __value
  FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se" w
  WHERE name IN($Station) 
  ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC
  LIMIT 1

panels.title: Temperatur

panels.description: Zeigt die aktuell gemessene Luftfeuchtigkeit der ausgewählten Wetterstationen an.

targets.rawSql:

  time_index AS time,
  entity_id AS __key,
  relativehumidity AS __value
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
  WHERE name in ($Station)
ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Relative Luftfeuchtigkeit

panels.description:
Zeigt die aktuell gemessene Niederschlagsintensität an. Die Angabe in mm entspricht dabei der tatsächlichen Regenmenge, wenn sich die Intensität eine Stunde lang nicht ändert.
Im gelben Bereich handelt es sich um starken Regen, im roten Bereich um sehr starken Regen (Definition gemäß DWD).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_index AS time,
  entity_id AS __key,
  precipitation AS __value
  FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
  WHERE name IN ($Station)
  ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC
  LIMIT 1

panels.title: Niederschlag

panels.description: Zeigt die gemessene Windgeschwindigkeit an den ausgewählten Wetterstationen an. Dabei handelt es sich nicht um die Böengeschwindigkeit. Die Einteilung erfolgt gemäß Beaufort-Skala: Gelb (ab 39 km/h oder 6 Bft; starker Wind), Rot (ab 75 km/h oder 9 Bft; Sturm)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_index AS time,
  entity_id AS __key,
  windspeed AS __value
  FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
  WHERE name IN ($Station)
  ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC
  LIMIT 1

panels.title: Windgeschwindigkeit

panels.description: Zeigt die aktuell gemessene Windrichtung als Richtungspfeil an. Die Darstellung ist dabei eingenordet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_index AS time,
  entity_id AS __key,
  winddirection AS __value
  FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
  WHERE entity_id = entity_id
  ORDER BY entity_id, time_index DESC
  LIMIT 1
